title: Machine files
viewerKept: Preview opens in the FabCore viewer without uploading the file to the machine.
unsupported: Remote storage is unavailable with this connection. The local viewer remains available.
retainedNotice: Only files uploaded through FabCore: this connection does not provide a complete storage listing.
cc2Notice: CC2 internal storage · native inventory limited to 300 entries. Download and preview depend on firmware. Old FabCore copies are not presented as still present.
ray5Notice: Native SD card · read while idle · 16 MiB per file · at most 300 files, 24 folders and 3 sublevels. Unreliable sizes and dates shown as unknown. No transfer to FDM printers.
ray5Idle: The SD card can only be read while idle. Any displayed list comes from the last reading.
unavailable: Connection unavailable. Check the machine before retrying.
upload: Upload a file to the machine
uploadWaiting: {name} · upload sent, waiting for storage confirmation…
truncated: List limited to 300 loaded files. Search and sorting apply to this list and do not guarantee that all storage locations were queried.
noRetained: No files uploaded through FabCore. Preinstalled files or files uploaded by other software are not listed here.
empty: No supported files found in the queried storage.
external: External spool only: no automatic AMS/CANVAS mapping. The file must be prepared for this machine and filament.
confirmPrint: The bed is clear and the file is prepared for this machine and material.
confirmLaser: I am present with laser protection, extraction and a clear work area. Machine profile, material, origin and power are checked.
notReady: This machine is no longer available to start the file.

errors.files-unavailable: Unable to read files. Refresh to retry.
errors.file-too-large: Invalid size or limit exceeded: 512 MiB, 16 MiB on Ray5.
errors.file-exists: A file with this name already exists.
errors.upload-busy: A command or transfer is already in progress.
errors.upload-failed: Upload was not confirmed. Check the list before retrying.
errors.upload-unknown: Upload outcome unknown. Check the list before retrying; no automatic replay.
errors.upload-proxy-limit: The proxy rejected the file size. Check its upload limit.
errors.command-state: The current state does not allow starting.
errors.command-busy: A command is already in progress.
errors.command-rejected: The machine rejected starting. Check its logs.
errors.command-unconfirmed: Outcome unknown. Check the machine and logs before sending another request. No automatic replay.
errors.bambu-authorization: Bambu command not authorized. In cloud, check imported PEMs; in LAN, check Developer Mode and logs.
errors.forbidden: This action requires an administrator account.
errors.project-multiple-plates: Projects containing multiple plates are not supported.
errors.project-no-gcode: No usable G-code in this project.
errors.invalid: The server rejected the request parameters.
errors.invalid-name: Invalid name: ASCII, no folders, at most 200 characters and a supported extension.
